title: object-history-server: select_versions, VersionLog, retention, rights cut, fold_restore
description:
Design: docs/design/object-history.md. Decisions: docs/design/DECISIONS.md.
Note key: H2. Crates: jmap-object-history-server. Size: M.

Spec: object-history-03 §2.1 (retention), §3 (selection rules), §3.1 (version numbering, ms precision, expires), §5.1 (history continues after restore; /changes classification), §8.2. Design: docs/design/object-history.md §3, §7, §10 (OHS bullet).

The crate holds pure helpers only: no handlers, no backend trait, no async.

- HistorySelector + select_versions implement §3 exactly:
  - flags first
  - historyAfter/historyBefore are strict; the live version is kept by after and dropped by before
  - historySkip counts from the newest, and the live version counts as one
  - historyLimit keeps the newest
  - notFound only when nothing remains after skip
- VersionLog<V = serde_json::Value> derives Clone and is keyed by (type, account, id). Each entry is Vec<Version{version, snapshot, replaced_ms}> plus destroyed_at.
  - Methods: record_replace, record_destroy, restore(id)->final, prune(now), select.
  - Equal-ms versions collapse; version numbering is stable; expires = replaced + max_duration; the clock (now ms) is injected.
  - prune discards oldest first. When the final version of a destroyed object goes, the whole object goes (decision 6(d)).
- HistoryRetention { max_duration, max_versions_per_object }.
- rights_changed_at cut: versions replaced before it are hidden; destroyed objects whose container rights changed after destruction are hidden.
- fold_restore: destroyed then restored in the window ⇒ updated; created in the window or destroyed before it ⇒ created; never destroyed.

Acceptance: table-driven tests written from the §3 prose:
- live/destroyed × the 4 flag combinations
- equal historyAfter excluded, live kept; historyBefore drops live
- the 'historySkip: 20 … 20 or fewer … notFound' case; live counts as one skipped entry
- historyLimit newest; historyLimit:0 puts the id in neither list
- hasOlder true for an unreturned older version
- equal-ms collapse
- fold_restore cases
- prune oldest-first, and a destroyed object vanishes with its final version (decision 6(d))
README/PLAN/public-api snapshot updated; one CHANGELOG bullet.
